main.description: Full-state recovery: enumerate a repo's record paths and their current CIDs, mirroring listRecords semantics. Record values are inlined by default; excludeValues returns metadata only. Boundary-gated: the caller only observes records within its enrolled boundaries. Intended as the fallback when the oplog (listRepoOps) returns OplogTruncated: the caller enumerates paths, diffs locally, and fetches misses. Callers must authenticate with a signed service JWT via the Authorization: Bearer header.

did.description: The DID of the repo to enumerate.

collection.description: Optional single collection to enumerate. When omitted, all collections are enumerated.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return in this page.

excludeValues.description: When true, record values are omitted and only path metadata is returned.

records.description: The record paths in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page. Absent when enumeration is complete.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: The requested repo does not exist.

recordPath.description: A record path with its current CID and optionally its value.

cid.description: The CID of the current record value.

value.description: The current record value, inlined by default. Omitted when excludeValues is true.
